ios.desc:
Word Fight is the two player game - where players face off to guess the same random five letter word in the least number of moves to win.

Challenge friends to see who can guess the mystery word the fastest. Win your games to improve your rating - and see who comes out as the winner in the ultimate Word Fight!

START A GAME
► Start a fight with a friend or a stranger. Each fight is battled out across multiple rounds - where each player makes a move to guess the word correctly. Each round finishes when both players have made their move. The first player to guess the word correctly wins!

WIN GAMES
► All players start with a rating of 1200 - which goes up every time you win a game. The rating system is based on the Chess Elo system - if you beat a higher rated player, your rating goes up more than if you beat a lower rated player.

SEE THEIR WORDS
► The game has two modes - one where your guesses are hidden, and one where you both see each other's words.


Word game aficionado? Check out our website, or follow us on Twitter to stay up-to-date on game news and other fun stuff.

https://wordfight.me
https://twitter.com/wordfightme
